system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown and slippers, leaning back in his chair, and Dr. Watson in tweed suit seated opposite, both turned toward each other mid-conversation","action":"Holmes reclines with fingertips pressed together while Watson leans forward, listening; their attention is caught as the door is flung open at the edge of the frame","setting":"221B Baker Street sitting room, cluttered with papers and books, a violin resting on a chair, pipe smoke hanging in the air","secondaryElements":"Dr. Grimesby Roylott, a heavyset elderly man in a dark frock-coat, half-visible in the doorway with a raised arm and a riding crop; a dim coal fire and a single oil lamp on the table","mood":"Tense and restrained, with gaslit intimacy and a sudden jolt of menace breaking the quiet","timeOfDay":"Morning, overcast grey daylight from the window mixed with firelight","composition":"Medium interior shot, Holmes and Watson in the foreground left and right, Roylott framed in the doorway at the rear center, depth created by the cluttered room"}
